say:3:1222654001:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you're quite good at interrogations. I almost want to learn a thing or two from you.
say:3:1222654001:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you're quite good at interrogations. I almost want to learn a thing or two from you.
say:3:1222654001:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you're quite good at interrogations. I almost want to learn a thing or two from you.

say:4:1222654002:0.text: Of course, Magister Merlin is good at many things, so you'd better ask humbly!
say:4:1222654002:0.source_cn: 梅林擅长的事多着呢，你可得虚心求教。
say:4:1222654002:0.male: Of course, Magister Merlin is good at many things, so you'd better ask humbly!
say:4:1222654002:0.female: Of course, Magister Merlin is good at many things, so you'd better ask humbly!

say:5:1222654003:1.text: Thanks to all of you, I understand what they're going on about.
say:5:1222654003:1.source_cn: 多亏了各位，我有些眉目了。

say:6:1222654004:0.text: Dante, the fisherman, just wants to figure out who's cutting his boat's rope.
say:6:1222654004:0.source_cn: 根据目前掌握的情报，渔民丹诺只想借机解决有人割他船绳的问题。

say:7:1222654005:1.text: The criminal is swift and decisive, she wouldn't waste time on something as trivial as that.
say:7:1222654005:1.source_cn: 对方是个干脆利落的杀手，不可能连割绳子这种小事都磨磨蹭蹭。

say:8:1222654006:1.text: Exactly. Dante's information isn't worth much.
say:8:1222654006:1.source_cn: 是的，所以我认为丹诺的情报不需要太在意。

say:9:1222654007:1.text: And the florist? She's just one of Sonja's many fans. She's desperate to meet her, so we can't rely on her claims either.
say:9:1222654007:1.source_cn: 至于那位卖花的姑娘，她是索尼娅的仰慕者，只是想见索尼娅...

say:10:1222654008:1.text: But that sailor, Gunnar, what he said was worth noting.
say:10:1222654008:1.source_cn: 而那个叫红锚的水手，他说的情报非常值得注意。

say:11:1222654009:1.text: Yeah! Even though he didn't see her face, anyone sneaking around trying to buy a boat is super suspicious!
say:11:1222654009:1.source_cn: 是啊，尽管他没见到买家的真容，但这时候偷偷摸摸买船的人...

say:12:1222654010:1.text: Let's send off the informants that are just stirring up trouble, then we'll have a proper conversation with Gunnar about the details.
say:12:1222654010:1.source_cn: 把那些浑水摸鱼的家伙打发走，再找红锚先生好好询问一些细节吧。
